from.n: view-push > Session > shows the output in a dialog as tall as the screen, a carriage return starting a line over

to.n: view-push > Session > shows the output in a dialog shrunk to fit the screen, a carriage return starting a line over

from.n: view-push > Session > wraps a line wider than the dialog, keeping all of it

to.n: view-push > Session > wraps a line wider than the dialog after its last space that fits, breaking a word wider than the dialog
